open_issues: For the supervisor, not the builder: docs/design/bidi-test.html's W04 "مع العزل" line still leaves the lone digit "1" un-isolated (the hand-authored reference's own typo). Bidi.cs and BidiWrapTests.cs have been reverted to the uniform, internally-consistent isolation rule (every anchored alphanumeric run isolated, digits included) per the prior verify-ui.json ruling. docs/ is outside my allowed paths, so the HTML reference and BUILD-PLAN.md decision record still need the supervisor's edit to agree.

The masked-date caret fix (finding 2) only forces a JS-side DOM/caret correction in the branch where the reformatted string equals the current Value (the literal reviewer recipe) — this fully fixes the 'rejected character sticks and cannot be typed over' defect (verified live: typing a non-digit anywhere in an already-formatted date, including mid-string, now leaves the value unchanged and restores the caret to the same spot instead of the end). It does NOT fully fix the separate case where a genuinely new digit is inserted in the middle of an already-complete date (that changes the formatted string, so Blazor's own re-render still resets the caret to the end afterward) — resolving that fully would need a post-render (OnAfterRenderAsync) caret restore, which is a larger change than the reviewer's fix recipe called for; flagging it in case the supervisor wants it addressed in a follow-up.

Live-host launch verification could not use the requested PowerShell CopyFromScreen technique: the WebView2 surface captured as solid white via GDI BitBlt/CopyFromScreen (a known DirectComposition/hardware-surface limitation, unrelated to this change) even though the process, CDP endpoint, and DOM were all healthy. I verified instead via CDP (Page.captureScreenshot for true pixel output, plus Runtime.evaluate to drive/read the masked-date input) — screenshots and interaction logs matched expectations in both themes; this substitution is noted for transparency.
notes:
All 5 findings from the review fixed:

1. (medium) src/Wakeel.Design/Bidi/Bidi.cs — removed the lone-digit special case in Wrap() (the `if (m.Value.Length == 1 && m.Value[0] is >= '0' and <= '9') return m.Value;` block and its comment); restored the single-line uniform rule `TokenPattern().Replace(text, m => Lri + m.Value + Pdi)`. tests/Wakeel.UI.Tests/BidiWrapTests.cs: restored the class doc comment's "One deliberate, documented deviation..." wording and the W04 test's expected value/comment to isolate "1" consistently with "D" — both now byte-identical (namespace aside) to HEAD's pre-move originals, verified against `git show HEAD:...`.

2. (low) src/Wakeel.Design/Components/WInput.razor — added `@inject IJSRuntime Js`, `@ref="_dateRef"` on the date `<input>`, and an `ElementReference _dateRef` field. OnDateInputAsync now detects when the reformatted mask equals the current Value (nothing for Blazor's renderer to diff) and in that case corrects the DOM directly via a new `wakeelUi.setInputValue(el, value, caret)` JS helper (added to src/Wakeel.Design/wwwroot/js/app.js, alongside a `wakeelUi.getSelectionStart(el)` helper used to read the caret before recomputing it), restoring the caret to the position implied by how many digits preceded it (via new `CountDigitsBefore`/`CaretForDigitCount` helpers) rather than letting a rejected character sit unstyled on screen. Verified live over CDP: typing a non-digit at the end or in the middle of an already-formatted "12/09/2026" now leaves the value unchanged and puts the caret back where it was, instead of leaving a stray character.

3. (low) tests/Wakeel.UI.Tests/Components/WInputTests.cs — added DateType_RendersMaskedTextInput_WithArabicPlaceholder (type/inputmode/maxlength/placeholder/calendar-icon-adornment), DateType_InsertsSeparators_AsDigitsAreTyped (1→1, 12→12, 120→12/0, 12092026→12/09/2026), DateType_NormalizesArabicIndicDigits_AndDropsOtherCharacters (Arabic-indic and mixed-junk input both → 12/09/2026), and DateType_UsesCallerPlaceholder_WhenSupplied.

4. (low) tests/Wakeel.UI.Tests/Components/WInputTests.cs — renamed/rewrote the tautological plaintext test to TextControl_PassesMixedArabicLatinValueThrough_Unchanged, which now asserts the rendered `value` attribute equals the mixed input exactly and contains no injected Bidi.Lri isolate; added a separate FieldControlCss_DeclaresUnicodeBidiPlaintext test that reads the shipped WInput.razor.css off disk and asserts the `.w-field-control` rule still declares `unicode-bidi: plaintext`.

5. (low) tests/Wakeel.UI.Tests/Components/WTopBarTests.cs — replaced the two unreachable `Assert.Empty(...QuerySelectorAll("br"))` assertions with falsifiable ones: name and role share one parent, that parent carries `w-topbar-user-text`, and the name element is a `<bdi>`.
